decisions.decision: Gate detects by KEY PRESENCE, not by parsing ports entries
decisions.rationale: Covers short and long mapping syntax for free; a parser that returns 'allowed' on an unrecognised shape is the silent gate this task removed

decisions.decision: Gate grew from 4 invariants to 7 during review remediation (I5 interpolation, I6 include/extends, I7 unlisted compose file)
decisions.rationale: All three came from confirmed reviewer bypasses; I5 was found by Codex alone and was NOT in the docstring's known holes

decisions.decision: Rejected the reviewer's proposed fix for the self-test allowlist
decisions.rationale: Importing ALLOWED_PUBLISHERS would make the test a self-referential oracle — a wrong allowlist edit rewrites its own expectations and stays green. Fixtures kept literal; generalised I4 cases added instead.

decisions.decision: Draw the packet-path diagram BEFORE the iptables work
decisions.rationale: DOCKER-USER must be drawn empty-and-dated; that empty box IS the finding. Drawing it after populating the chain loses the record of why the rules exist.

decisions.decision: agy migrated to the native Linux build (1.1.27)
decisions.rationale: The Chocolatey .exe ran its shell as PowerShell on a UNC path, so it could not see WSL's Docker or any POSIX tool — the cause of the long-standing review wedge
